item.title: Explore, Climb, and Play: Discover the Explorer Room at Matt Ross Community Center in Overland Park
item.description: Looking for a free indoor playground in Overland Park? Check out the Explorer Room at Matt Ross Community Center! This 3-story adventure zone is perfect for kids 2–10 and open to the public for play, all year round.

item.description: Celebrate SCHEELS Overland Park’s 10th birthday with free Ferris wheel rides, arcade games, and gift card giveaways! Don’t miss this limited-time family fun event happening now in the heart of Kansas City.

item.title: Rev Up Family Fun at Overland Park’s New Indoor Racetrack
item.description: Get ready for high-speed fun, KC moms! Andretti Indoor Karting & Games is opening in Overland Park this summer—featuring electric go-karts, laser tag, arcade games, and more. It’s the ultimate indoor family entertainment spot your kids (and you!) will love.

item.description: A brand-new, ultra-accessible amusement park—Michael’s Wonder World—is opening mid‑2026 in Olathe, offering inclusive fun for families of all abilities.
